component: Message header Star-button semantics and tests

quotes.text: The multi message header Star button should not expose checkbox state.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The single-message and multi-message Star controls are native buttons whose aria-pressed value follows existing flag state. The multi-message test directly checks pressed and unpressed states and verifies that checkbox state is absent. Recipient popup and website roles are separate source changes; these three assertions do not directly test their keyboard behavior or a native accessible tree.
title: Message-header Star buttons expose pressed state and the multi-message test checks it directly
